summary: Copies two 12-byte (3-dword) sub-structures out of element a2 of a 28-byte-stride struct array whose base pointer is stored at this+0x154 (index 85). The first 12 bytes go to a3, the second 12 bytes (offset +12) go to a4. Returns a4. Pure read/copy getter with no side effects; called from AI-driver and proximity paths.

local_names.v4: source pointer for first 3-dword block (array element base)
local_names.v5: source pointer for second 3-dword block (array element base + 12)

operations.description: Compute array element base: v4 = this[85] + 28 * a2, where this[85] is the array base pointer stored at this+0x154.
Copy first 3 dwords of the element into *a3: a3[0]=v4[0], a3[1]=v4[1], a3[2]=v4[2].
Compute second block source: v5 = this[85] + 28 * a2 + 12.
Copy next 3 dwords (offset +12) into *a4: a4[0]=v5[0], a4[1]=v5[1], a4[2]=v5[2].
